name: Kongflix Poster Scanner
description: Scans movie and series libraries for items missing a poster and forces Jellyfin's own agents to refresh them.
overview: Scan and refresh items missing a poster

versions.changelog: Fix MissingMethodException on Jellyfin 10.11.x: retarget to Jellyfin.Controller 10.11.11 / .NET 9 (ILibraryManager.GetItemList's return type changed, and TaskTriggerInfo.TriggerDaily was replaced by TaskTriggerInfoType.DailyTrigger). Requires a Jellyfin 10.11.x+ server.
Initial release: scans movie and series libraries for items missing a poster and forces a full metadata/image refresh via Jellyfin's own agents.
